subject: general
question: Who among the following was the disciple of Ramakrishna Paramahansa?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Swami Vivekananda**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Narendranath Dutta, renowned as Swami Vivekananda,** emerged as one of the most prominent disciples of** Ramakrishna Paramahansa**.
 
• Born in 1863, Swami Vivekananda propagated the belief that all religions emphasize the unity of God and the equality of humanity.
 
• Following Ramakrishna's passing, Swami Vivekananda played a pivotal role in popularizing his teachings and establishing both the Ramakrishna Order and the Ramakrishna Mission.
 
• The Ramakrishna Order offers spiritual guidance to both householders and monastics, while the Ramakrishna Mission is dedicated to charitable endeavors, education, and social welfare.
 
• Functioning as a non-profit organization, the Ramakrishna Mission aims to facilitate individuals in their quest for spiritual enlightenment and salvation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Dayanand Saraswati **was an eminent Indian philosopher, social reformer, and the founder of the Arya Samaj, a movement aimed at revitalizing Hinduism. His seminal work, "Satyarth Prakash," remains a cornerstone text, offering profound insights into Vedic philosophy and elucidating various human duties and concepts.
 
• **Swami Sahajananda,** a notable Indian politician, served as a Member of the Legislative Assembly of Tamil Nadu. He represented the Chidambaram constituency as an Indian National Congress candidate in both the 1952 and 1957 elections, contributing significantly to the state's legislative proceedings.
 
• **Swami Shraddhanand, **also known as Mahatma Munshi Ram Vij, was a revered Arya Samaj sannyasi and a prominent figure in India's struggle for independence. He dedicated his life to promoting the teachings of Dayanand Saraswati and played a pivotal role in advocating social reform and national awakening.
